```{r}

# ==========================================================
# Load Libraries
# ==========================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

# ==========================================================
# Midnight Narrative Palette
# ==========================================================

midnight_narrative <- c(
  midnight = "#1D3557",
  coral = "#E76F51",
  blush = "#F4A261",
  rosewood = "#B56576",
  sage = "#6C9A8B",
  linen = "#F1FAEE",
  ink = "#222222"
)

# ==========================================================
# Custom Theme Function
# ==========================================================

theme_midnight_narrative <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = midnight_narrative["linen"], color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = midnight_narrative["linen"], color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 18,
        color = midnight_narrative["midnight"],
        margin = margin(b = 8)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        color = midnight_narrative["ink"],
        margin = margin(b = 15)
      ),
      axis.text = element_text(color = midnight_narrative["ink"]),
      axis.title = element_text(color = midnight_narrative["ink"]),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey85"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

```

## Data Section

```{r}

palmtrees <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2025/2025-03-18/palmtrees.csv')

palm <- palmtrees

```

## Analysis

```{r}

pareto_data <- palm %>%
  count(acc_genus) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 15) %>%
  mutate(
    cumulative = cumsum(n),
    cumulative_percent = cumulative / sum(n),
    acc_genus = fct_reorder(acc_genus, n)
  )

ggplot(pareto_data, aes(x = acc_genus)) +
  
  geom_col(aes(y = n),
           fill = midnight_narrative["linen"],
           color = midnight_narrative["midnight"],
           width = 0.8) +
  
  geom_col(
    data = pareto_data[which.max(pareto_data$n), ],
    aes(y = n),
    fill = midnight_narrative["coral"],
    width = 0.8
  ) +
  
  geom_line(aes(y = cumulative_percent * max(n), group = 1),
            color = midnight_narrative["sage"],
            linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  geom_point(aes(y = cumulative_percent * max(n)),
             color = midnight_narrative["sage"],
             size = 2.5) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Count",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . / max(pareto_data$n),
      name = "Cumulative %",
      labels = percent
    )
  ) +
  
  coord_flip() +
  
  labs(
    title = "A Small Number of Genera Dominate Observations",
    subtitle = "Cumulative percentage reveals concentration of detections",
    x = NULL
  ) +
   theme_midnight_narrative()
```
